xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5339: Conversation messages: make references to other conversations clickable

plan.title: Conversation messages: make references to other conversations clickable
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A message that names another conversation (20261113-6031, conv-20261113-6031, conv 3904, /conv/3904) renders as plain text or inline code; the operator cannot click it to open that conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Inside a conversation transcript, ChatMarkdown pre-scans the message for reference keys, resolves them against the ['conversations'] list and, for unlisted (archived) keys, GET /api/conversations/<key>. The resolved map feeds a new remark plugin (links resolved plain-text references and whole-value inline code) and the existing a component (generated and hand-written /conv/ links). A ConversationReferenceLink opens the conversation in the deck through useOpenConversation (extended to take a Conversation object) via a nullable opener context mounted in App; modified clicks and hosts without deck navigation open a new tab.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Linked conversation names (@<env>/<name>) and non-date names (conv-flywheel, 20260706-3577-post-clear-...) are not recognised
- Host-less text such as overdeck.localhost/conv/3904 is not linked
- Inline code holding a reference plus other text is not split
- No new server route and no server change; usePriorityConversation is unchanged
- Messages over 50,000 characters never link
- ChatMarkdown outside a conversation transcript (PRD viewer, dialogs, activity feed) is unchanged
- No hover prefetch and no title-less optimistic links
- No second Markdown pipeline and no new code component
- A linked conversation's own transcript links nothing (its ids belong to the owner machine)

autoDecisions.summary: Render a reference as text until it resolves; never as a title-less link
autoDecisions.rationale: Required behaviour item 3 and its test ('an unknown one renders text') outrank the checkpoint's optional title-less rendering.

autoDecisions.summary: Name pattern accepts a 4-character lowercase hex suffix (\d{8}-[0-9a-f]{4})
autoDecisions.rationale: Summary forks and vault continues name conversations YYYYMMDD-<randomUUID().slice(0,4)>; about 400 of 3905 local names carry a letter in that suffix, so a digits-only pattern misses real conversations.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve unlisted keys with the existing GET /api/conversations/:id under a separate query key
autoDecisions.rationale: The list excludes archived rows; the existing route resolves id or name, archived included, and 404s cheaply, so no new route (and no no-loss-matrix/route-scopes row) is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Inline code links only when its whole trimmed value is one reference
autoDecisions.rationale: Splitting a code span into code/link/code pieces changes its look; the observed case is whole-value code.

autoDecisions.summary: The numbered form links the whole phrase 'conv 3904'
autoDecisions.rationale: The phrase is what the reader sees as the reference; linking only the digits is a smaller target.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard host = same origin, or both URL and page on loopback hosts
autoDecisions.rationale: Numeric ids are machine-local; Copy link uses window.location.origin, and overdeck.localhost vs localhost:3011 are the same machine.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate on the transcript context (ConversationPullRequestContext); tool rows inside a transcript also link, bounded to 20 lookups per message
autoDecisions.rationale: The context marks a conversation transcript and carries the viewed conversation's name for item 6; other ChatMarkdown hosts stay unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Without deck navigation (pop-outs, /m, issue drawer) a resolved reference is a new-tab link
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the documented issue-link behaviour; useDeckNavigation throws outside App's provider.

autoDecisions.summary: A hand-written link to the viewed conversation stays an in-app link
autoDecisions.rationale: Item 6 targets generated references; a link the agent wrote on purpose is kept.

autoDecisions.summary: A linked conversation's transcript links nothing
autoDecisions.rationale: Its text refers to the owner machine's ids and names; resolving them locally would open the wrong conversation.

items.title: Add the conversation reference patterns module

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 and decisions D7, D10, D11. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/conversationReferences.ts exporting splitConversationReferences, parseConversationReference, parseConversationHref, collectConversationReferenceKeys (default limit 20, fenced ``` and ~~~ blocks removed before scanning), mayContainConversationReference, and the shared ConversationRef / ConversationRefMap types plus EMPTY_CONVERSATION_REFS. Use exactly the three regexes of D11 (name /(?<![\w/.-])(conv-)?(\d{8}-[0-9a-f]{4})(?![\w-]|[./]\w)/g, numbered /\b(?:conversation|conv)[ \t]+#?(\d{1,7})(?![\w-])/gi, path /(?<![\w.:/-])\/conv\/(\d{1,9}|\d{8}-[0-9a-f]{4})(?![\w/-]|\.\w)/g); earliest match wins, no overlaps. Keys: decimal id string for numbered and numeric path forms; bare name (no conv- prefix) for name forms. parseConversationHref accepts /conv/<key> with optional ?query/#hash, and absolute http(s) URLs whose origin equals location.origin or whose hostname and location.hostname are both loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, *.localhost). Conversation is a type-only import from ../components/CommandDeck/ConversationList.

Given 2026-11-13, c9906c2370a, 555-123-4567, 12345678-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678, 20260706-3577-post-clear-78e2e542, abc-20261113-6031, conversations 12, conv-20261113-6031/state.json and 20261113-6031.md, splitConversationReferences returns no keyed segment; given 'See 20261113-6031.' it returns the key 20261113-6031

collectConversationReferenceKeys returns no key for a reference that appears only inside a fenced code block, and returns at most 20 keys for a text holding 25 distinct references

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 and decision D8. In useOpenConversation.ts change the returned callback to (target: string | Conversation | null) => void: name = string/null target as-is, else target.name; conv = list row with that name, else the object itself. Keep the rest of the body unchanged and update the header comment. Create components/chat/ConversationLinkOpener.tsx with ConversationLinkOpenerContext (createContext<ConversationLinkOpener | null>(null)), ConversationLinkOpenerProvider (calls useOpenConversation(null) once and provides it) and useConversationLinkOpener(). In App.tsx wrap <AppRoutes .../> inside <main> (under DeckNavigationProvider, App.tsx:792) with <ConversationLinkOpenerProvider>. New test file uses TestDeckNavigationProvider and vi.mock('../useProjectScope') returning an empty conversation list and a resolveConversationProjectName stub.

items.title: Given an empty conversation list, when the callback is called with the object { id: 3904, name: '20261113-6031' }, then TestDeckNavigationProvider records openInDeck with conversationRouteKey '3904'
Given a listed conversation name string, the callback still records openInDeck for it, and an unlisted name string still records selectProject, as before the change

Add the useConversationReferences resolution hook

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and decisions D1, D9, D12. useConversationReferences(text, currentConversationName) computes keys with collectConversationReferenceKeys; returns EMPTY_CONVERSATION_REFS and enables no query when parseLinkedConversationName(currentConversationName) from @overdeck/contracts is non-null (a linked transcript); reads the ['conversations'] query (queryFn fetchConversations from components/CommandDeck/ConversationList, enabled: keys.length > 0, staleTime 10000, refetchOnWindowFocus false, a select memoized on keys that keeps only rows with origin neither 'linked' nor 'vault' whose String(id) or name equals a key); for keys missing from the settled list runs useQueries with queryKey ['conversation-reference', key], staleTime 300000, refetchOnWindowFocus false, retry false, queryFn fetchWithTimeout('/api/conversations/' + encodeURIComponent(key)) returning null on 404 and throwing on other non-OK. Returns a ConversationRefMap (routeKey = String(id), title, isCurrent = name === currentConversationName, conversation = the row) whose identity changes only when its content changes; EMPTY_CONVERSATION_REFS when empty. Implementation checkpoint D12: if lint:circular reports a new cycle, use a local fetch('/api/conversations') query function instead and keep only the type import.

items.title: Given text with no reference candidates, the hook returns EMPTY_CONVERSATION_REFS and the stubbed fetch is never called
Given a key present in the /api/conversations response, the hook resolves it without requesting /api/conversations/<key>
Given the unlisted key 20260824-343d, the hook requests /api/conversations/20260824-343d exactly once and returns an entry for it; given a key whose request returns 404, the map has no entry for it

Given currentConversationName equal to a resolved row's name, the hook returns that entry marked isCurrent true; given the linked name @env-1/20261113-6031, the hook returns EMPTY_CONVERSATION_REFS and the stubbed fetch is never called
Add the remarkConversationReferences plugin

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 and decision D5. remarkConversationReferences({ refs }) returns a transformer that walks the mdast like remarkBareFileTextLinks (ChatMarkdown.tsx:338): skips code, link, linkReference and definition nodes; splits text children with splitConversationReferences and turns segments whose key is in refs and not isCurrent into { type: 'link', url: '/conv/' + routeKey, title: null, children: [{ type: 'text', value }] }; replaces an inlineCode child whose parseConversationReference(value.trim()) resolves (not current) with { type: 'link', url, title: null, children: [theInlineCodeNode] }. Empty refs returns immediately. Tests build mdast trees by hand and call the transformer directly; do not import unified or remark-parse (not declared frontend dependencies).

items.title: Given a paragraph text node 'Tell 20261113-6031 now' and refs holding that key with routeKey 3904, the transformer produces text 'Tell ', a link node with url /conv/3904 and text child '20261113-6031', then text ' now'
Given an inlineCode node with value '20261113-6031', the transformer replaces it with a link node whose only child is the original inlineCode node
Given a code (fenced) node, an inlineCode 'pan tell 20261113-6031', a text with an unknown key, or a text with an isCurrent key, the transformer preserves each node unchanged
Add the ConversationReferenceLink component

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. ConversationReferenceLink({ conversationRef, className, children }) renders <a href=/conv/<routeKey> target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer' title={title ?? name} data-conversation-id={routeKey}>. onClick: when useConversationLinkOpener() is non-null and the click is a plain left click (copy the guard at TranscriptIssueLink.tsx:50-51: defaultPrevented, button !== 0, meta/ctrl/shift/alt), preventDefault and call the opener with conversationRef.conversation; otherwise do nothing so the browser opens a new tab.

items.title: Given an opener context, a plain click calls the opener once with the conversation row, fireEvent.click returns false, and window.open is not called
Given an opener context, Ctrl-click and Meta-click do not call the opener
Given no opener context, a plain click calls nothing and the anchor keeps target=_blank and href /conv/<routeKey>
The anchor title is the conversation title, and is the conversation name when the title is null
